item.title: Legal
item.author: awawa@betterwebsites.dev (betterwebsites.dev)
item.description:
TL;DR

  • This is a static site and we don’t collect any personal data of visitors.
  • Some data may go through the site’s host Cloudflare and their privacy policy applies to that.
  • Cloudflare analytics are enabled but no personal identifiers of site visitors are obtained by us.
  • If an embedded item like a YouTube video is on a page, they may track you through that (embedded items are similar to visiting the actual site), and you are beholden to their policies.
  • If you find an issue, let us know by sending an email to: awawa@betterwebsites.dev
  • Always do your own research before acting on any information or advice that you read here. By using the site, you agree to waive liability per license terms.
  • Feel free to share, use, or remix our content! Just be sure to follow the license terms.
  • We may share things here under fair use, no copyright infringement is intended.

The Privacy Policy

We, betterwebsites.dev, care about privacy and wish to make this policy as inclusive of that goal as possible. This is a static site, meaning there is no database for data entry from a user of the site. Further, this site contains no Javascript and is arranged in HTML/CSS for maximizing security. This site is hosted on Cloudflare. Cloudflare has their own analytics that are “privacy-first” and defines what data they collect and what they can know about you. They state that:

Cloudflare Web Analytics does not use any client-side state, such as cookies or localStorage, to collect usage metrics. We also don’t “fingerprint” individuals via their IP address, User Agent string, or any other data for the purpose of displaying analytics.

— Cloudflare Analytics

Cloudflare’s privacy policy can be found on their website.

This site is built without cookies and does not contain any trackers. Embedded content (eg from YouTube, etc.) may contain their own cookies and trackers, and the linked sites own privacy policies will apply. Embedded content is akin to visiting the actual site itself, and the embedded sites privacy policy will apply.

We do not collect any personally identifiable user information of visitors to our site.

Since we do not collect any personally identifiable information of visitors to our site:

  • there is no one to share or sell the information to
  • no place it is collected from (where)
  • no reason for the information to be collected (why)
  • no application of “how information is collected” because it’s not collected in the first place
  • no application of “rights users have over their data” as it’s not collected in the first place
  • You can contact us via awawa@betterwebsites.dev if you have questions or concerns about this policy

Disclaimers and terms of use

  • We are not a lawyer and nothing on this site is constituted as legal advice
  • We are not a physician and nothing on this site is constituted as medical advice
  • We are not a financial professional and nothing on this site is constituted as professional financial advice
  • On this site, we express opinions and views which are our own and do not represent our employers or associations with which we are a part

item.title: Now
item.author: awawa@betterwebsites.dev (betterwebsites.dev)
item.description:
hewoo,

This theme started off long ago as a simple set of html and css files that I manually edited to have basically a landing page with my links to other things.

Then it evolved into a full Hugo blog theme that I released in early 2025 which ran the site.

Until now.

The idea is simple: the designs of sites like https://en.wikipedia.org, https://craigslist.com, https://old.reddit.com, https://grapheneos.org, and https://text.npr.org/ are all cool and based (or in the words of one of my friends, “those sites fuck”).

I wanted to make a blog theme that’s simple, multi-author capable, was easy to read, and most importantly: that it fucks.

So, here is my humble and free offering, MIT licensed.

If anything about this theme is wrong or could be improved, lemme know by going to the site code and filing an issue or proposing a patch.

I wrote this page with a more normie person in mind, as I believe more folks should get comfortable taking back our means of computation. This is a static site and it can be deployed anywhere.

I encourage more of us to write.

— Raven

item.title: About
item.author: awawa@betterwebsites.dev (betterwebsites.dev)
item.description:
This is an overview of the main features of the theme.

theme features (this is a level 2 header)

  • full-text rss
  • tags
  • monospace or sans-serif system fonts
  • auto dark and light modes
  • multi-author support with author pages
  • optional banner images on the top of posts
  • optional table of contents
  • 88x31 buttons on homepage
  • webrings on homepage
  • h-card for basic indieweb support
  • link previews with fallback image (opengraph)
  • image processing with hugo
  • float images left or right with text-wrapping
  • easily modifiable for making it your own
  • specific CSS for printing, with QR codes automatically generated that link to the live page
  • sitemap at the bottom of the page that shows all pages on the site
  • a:visited to keep track of where you’ve been on the page
  • date in ISO8601 format
  • default author setting
  • neocritter emojis via shortcode (supply your own)

for a better view of theme, check out /posts/theme/
